editorial:
Imagine watching your whole world go up in flames while three ruthless killers take everything from you. That is exactly how things start for Kojiro. You get pulled right into a brutal revenge story set in old Japan, where the government is falling apart and ninjas are everywhere. The movie follows Kojiro as he grows up with one goal: finding the three men who murdered his father in that farmhouse. It has a gritty, old-school feel that makes you really root for the underdog as he trains himself to become a deadly warrior.

What really makes this one work are the fight scenes. You will love seeing the different weapons, especially that crazy sickle-and-chain. The pacing is quick, and the acting feels raw and honest. While some of the effects look a bit dated since it is from 1966, the tension still hits hard. It is a wild ride from start to finish.
endingExplained: Kojiro finally tracks down the three killers and faces them in a series of intense fights. He uses everything he learned to outsmart them one by one. In the final clash, he manages to defeat the lead attacker, bringing a closed loop to his lifelong quest for revenge. He finds peace knowing his father is avenged, but the movie leaves you thinking about how violence only leads to more loss before the screen fades to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic martial arts movies and revenge stories.
